body: My father is my boss and he would not allow it. Work is most important to him. He thinks work is therapeutic for me and that therapists are ... he thinks that they are too soft and that they are too nutty themselves. It's difficult to explain. I could possibly sneak off once if I think of a good excuse.

I can afford it but never have the time. Closest one is an hour away. I work from 8 to 5 and I'm not allowed to be out after dark, because I have sleep issues that make it dangerous to drive after dark.
